questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: There were different housing optiong available. They were made available with a first come, first sever princip, so you should be prepared to select them pretty fast.

Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration process is easy if you have found the right courses. In my case, it was diffucult to find courses that didn't overlap. There wasn't many relevant courses, which made me take courses that I didn't want to. The course description also wasn't clear with what the requirements/needs were for the courses.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The website had a timeplanner/calender which made it easy to see what courses overlapped

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: There was two courses that I wanted to take, that I then couldn't due to overlap

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be careful when picking courses where previous courses are needed. I took "Synthetic Approaches in Medicinal Chemistry" and "Advanced Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry" where previous knowledge/courses could have been very helpful. Especially "Synthetic Medicinal Approaches" is a course where a lot of students fail, so make sure that you have a good knowledge of organic chemistry if you want to pass that course.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The courses was on a varity of levels. Som course like "Human Cells in Culture", "Statistics with R" and "Biomolecular Screening" was pretty easy. And then courses like "Synthetic Approaches in Medicinal Chemistry" and "Advanced Radiopharmaceutical chemistry" was on an advanced level.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The teaching style differ from course to course. In courses where the class is quite small (8 people), you will be more forced to participate in classes with presentations. In bigger courses (+20 people) there will only be lectures.
